messages.subject: Can I get correct links for mark recapture model examples?
parts:
I have seen several links in this discussion board for mark recapture model examples in STAN, which are supposed to reside as branches on github. However, these links do not work. Apparently the material has been removed. Can someone please direct to these examples?

Tyrell DeWeber

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Can I get correct links for mark recapture model examples?
parts:
Sorry -- that was my bad. I removed the branches in our latest
round of cleanup but haven't yet pushed the new models to the example-models
repo, which is where they belong.

There's an example of the CJS mark-recapture model in the manual now
and example code on branch stan-egs-import in the repo stan-dev/example-models.

It should be merged soon.

I know Fraenzi Korner-Nievergelt also had more elaborate random-effects
versions of the CJS model --- they'll probably be in her new book which is
due out this month!

- Bob
